messages:
zoe: Noticed invoice-preview totals +2.1% for tenants hitting policy=multi-route after yesterday's routing tweak. Quick sanity check shows per-request meters match logs.
ale: I think stream chunks + finalize events are both reaching metering. Our dedupe key previously included route tag; if fallback changes route we lose dedupe.
rukesh: Repro example: stream_chunk (route=multi-route) then finalize (route=small-fallback) same fingerprint -> counted twice.
zoe: Can we short-term debounce stream_chunk ingestion for 30s to avoid dupes? ops: is that simple?
ops: yes, can toggle a 30s fingerprint debounce in aggregator as emergency switch. Low risk.
ale: Long term: add canonical_fp + dedupe_version. Aggregator will prefer canonical_fp when present; clientlibs can emit via header X-Redwood-CanonFP.
billing-bot: alert: 1.1% of metering events missing canonical_fp in last 24h (edge:v3 rollout incomplete).
rukesh: Rollout plan: 1) aggregator accepts canonical_fp but defaults to legacy; 2) enable canonical dedupe in 5% canary; 3) 12h shadow compare; 4) ramp if delta <0.1%. Block preview emails for canary tenants.
zoe: Add dashboard metric dup_candidate_rate (pct fingerprints with >1 event) and canary_delta_percent for visibility.
ops: I'll schedule canary, and enable debounce toggle if spike gets worse.
ale: I'll open PR for schema + aggregator flag and include shadow-compare.
zoe: Action items: ale -> PR, rukesh -> backfill plan if needed, ops -> canary + debounce toggle, billing -> prep credit runbook. Update here when PR lands.
